## A. Fetch & pre-filter
Runs daily at 7am (or manually). Reads **Settings** from the Google Sheet, fetches jobs from Himalayas and Arbeitnow (1 request/second, retries on failure), standardizes the fields, removes duplicates, and applies cheap rule-based checks (age, title, agency blocklist, remote, English).

## B. AI checks (Claude Haiku)
Skips jobs already in **Leads** or **Rejected** (no repeat AI calls, no duplicate rows). Claude judges each new job (remote, English, relevant, real company vs agency) and returns strict JSON with a fit score and 2-3 concrete hooks. **Apply AI Decision** turns judgments into keep/reject using the Settings tab. Failed AI answers are rejected as *AI check failed*, never lost.

## C. Outreach messages (Claude Sonnet)
Uses the **Active** prompt from the **Prompts** tab (switch tone without touching this workflow). Fixed guardrails are added in code: only facts from the posting and the RAY pitch, no invented claims, no placeholders. Each lead is added to **Leads** with its message, fit score and prompt version.

## D. Wrap-up (every run)
Every path ends here, so this runs even when there are no new leads.

- **Rejected**: AI rejections plus meaningful rule rejections (agency, not remote, not English), upserted by URL (no duplicates)
- **Run Log**: one row per run with counts and warnings
- **Expired**: untouched leads past their expiry are marked *Expired* and their job text cleared (Himalayas API terms)
- **Daily summary** email with the top new leads

Crashes are emailed by the separate *RAY Lead Engine: Error Alert* workflow.
